text:
rachel: Hey folks, accepted the org invite but when I try to push I get 403 and the UI keeps prompting me to finish SSO. I tried SMS 2FA but the org disallows SMS. Who can help? cc @priya

priya: welcome rachel! try to paste the exact push error and what github username you accepted the invite with.

rachel: error:
```
$ git push origin feature/metrics
remote: Permission to redwood-inference/service.git denied to rachel-personal.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/service.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```
I accepted with `rachel.work` not personal, but I was forced into an SSO flow that asked to enroll 2FA. I only had SMS set up on my personal account and the dialog said "SMS not allowed, register hardware or TOTP" and then it looped back.

it-support: two things could be happening: 1) your local git auth might be using credentials tied to `rachel-personal`; 2) your work account might not have completed the org-enforced TOTP/hardware step. Run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste outputs.

rachel: `gh auth status` shows I'm authenticated as `rachel-personal`. `ssh -T` yields `Hi rachel-personal! You've successfully authenticated...` So local keys/auth are still on personal.

priya: ok easiest path is to re-auth as work account and enroll TOTP. Steps:
1) clear local auth: `gh auth logout --hostname github.com` and remove cached tokens from credential helper.
2) `gh auth login` and choose web or token and pick `rachel.work`.
3) in GitHub web: Settings -> Security -> Set up TOTP (use Authenticator app) or register YubiKey under SSH and WebAuthn.
If you prefer SSH, add a separate work SSH key and use SSH host alias.

rachel: tried that but the SSO enrollment page blocked me when I tried to set TOTP because it still detected SMS as primary on the personal account. Any way to force TOTP enrollment for the work account?

devops: if your company email is not verified on the `rachel.work` account, SSO can redirect odd. Check Settings -> Emails and verify the work address. If the invite was accepted by `rachel.work` but the email isn't verified, enforcement won't complete. Also, sometimes GitHub shows an "identity conflict" banner if multiple accounts share emails. If that's the case, we can re-send invite to the exact username we want to use.

it-support: quick fix we can do while you sort TOTP: add `rachel-personal` to the repo as a temporary collaborator (short-term) or re-send invite to the `rachel.work` username. Which do you prefer?

rachel: prefer not to mix personal access. Please re-send invite to `rachel.work` and I'll verify email + setup TOTP.

it-support: re-sent invite to `rachel.work`. Also remove local creds and re-login as advised. One more tip: if you hit a WebAuthn/YubiKey enrollment loop, try a different browser (Safari is more reliable on mac) or disable extensions that block cross-origin requests.

github-bot: invite re-sent to rachel.work for org redwood-inference (reason: SSO/account conflict).

rachel: re-logged in as rachel.work, verified work email, set up TOTP using Authy, completed SSO. `gh auth status` now shows `rachel.work`. I also replaced the SSH key to a work-specific key and updated ssh config.

it-support: try pushing now.

rachel: push succeeded :tada: — thanks! Two onboarding notes: 1) call out in docs that SMS 2FA is disallowed and to prepare a TOTP app or security key before accepting invites, 2) remind folks to verify work email before SSO.

priya: great suggestions, filing doc update. Welcome aboard and glad that worked!

it-support: resolved and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
